source.research: Olympus item 5 structured research and verification, 2026-10-21 (not published; pinned by researchSHA256)

status: Per-rank talent modifiers in modifier space. They are not final character totals: the sheet combines components only under the stated stacking assumption in naked60-186.json (evaluation.stacking, Classic rule, grade E whenever two or more effects are combined), never across scopes or unmet conditions, and procs are never added to the sheet.

grades.A: Exact from current-build client data: a DB2 trait curve equals the rank-text series.
grades.B: DB2 value with a semantic reading (no trait curve, or the curve is not the stat itself).

tiers.A: Unconditional character-sheet stat (applies whenever the talent is learned).
tiers.B: Scoped or conditional static stat (form, weapon, shield, school, named spell, active pet or self-buff).
tiers.C: Proc or temporary effect; never added to the character sheet.
tiers.M: Throughput modifier (damage, healing or critical-damage percentage); shown, not added to sheet stats.

ops.add_pp: Add percentage points to a chance (crit, hit, dodge, parry, block, hit taken, expertise).
ops.add_flat: Add a flat amount (defense skill, resistances, maximum energy, rage generation).
ops.mul_total_pct: Multiply the total of the target by (1 + value/100); statBasis says which total.
ops.pct_of_stat: Add value% of sourceStat (statBasis total) to the target.
ops.pct_of_level: Add coefficientPerLevel x character level to the target (values are % of level, or units per level when unit is per_level).
ops.regen_while_casting_pct: Percent of Spirit-based mana regeneration that continues while casting; sum across sources, capped at 100 in the Classic rule.
ops.crit_damage_bonus_pct: Percent increase of the critical strike damage bonus (throughput only).
ops.damage_taken_pct: Percent damage taken modifier; direction reduce means less damage taken.
ops.armor_ignore_pct: Percent of the target's armor ignored.
ops.proc: Event-driven or periodic effect; never added to the character sheet. procEffect says what it does while active.

conditionGrammar: Each entry is one requirement and all entries must hold. "kind:value" with "|" separating alternatives inside one entry. Kinds: attack, weapon, shield, items, school, spell, except_spell, spell_type, spell_group, form, pet_active, no_pet_active, self_buff, target, incoming, trigger, in_combat, party_aura. An empty list means unconditional.

auraReadings.note: Emulator/retail aura enum reading used for semantic grade B notes; numbers are as stored in SpellEffect.
auraReadings.4: DUMMY (effect handled by server script; value meaning from the rank text)

rules: Drift: if a rank text hash (textSHA256) or a DB2 curve changes, withhold the numbers and show the text.
appliesNaked false means the component needs an equipped item (item armor, weapon type, shield, wand, ranged weapon, off-hand or weapon imbue) and adds 0 to a naked character.
Procs (op proc, tier C) and throughput modifiers (tier M) are shown, never added to sheet stats.
scopeAmbiguous true means the rank text gives no scope that the classic talent had; treat the value as text-exact but the scope as unverified.
Grade U never appears here: every listed value is text-exact and DB2-checked.
